results.description:
Two manuscripts in one audiobook:
How to Talk to Anyone: What You Weren´t Taught about Small Talk, Social Skills, and Talking to Anybody About AnythingHow to Make People Like You: Psychological Tricks, Habits, and Jokes to Immediately Increase Your Charisma and Ability to Influence People
Don’t be concerned about having difficulty talking or interacting with people; you can change. If you want to better yourself, begin now. The first thing to do is to educate yourself on the subject, and this book’s information will do just that.

In the first part of this audiobook, you will:
Discover methods for overcoming pessimismLearn about people’s most common communication errorsFind your best – and most effective technique for developing your social abilitiesLearn how to strike up a conversation with anybody – any timeMaster small talkDiscover the importance of eye contact (the right kind) and mastering your body languageBecome astute about what others’ body language means
The second part of this audiobook will teach you habits and tricks to widen your social circle and be someone who naturally attracts people. You will no longer be worried about what kind of first impression you’re making because your natural charisma will speak for itself.

In the second part of this audiobook, you will:
Learn about what to do and what to avoid making others like youUnderstand what it takes to become a more interesting personLearn to ask the right questions to win people overUnderstand the value of listening to understand rather than listening to respondLearn how to have welcoming body languageLearn to proudly own your weirdnessAnd much, much more!
Click on the “add to cart” button and learn How to Talk to Anybody.
